sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
sections.body: We collect information that you provide directly to us, such as when you register for launch updates or contact technical support. This includes your name, email address, and inquiry details.

sections.heading: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use the information we collect strictly to provide, maintain, and support our products, notify you of software launches, and respond to technical inquiry tickets.

sections.heading: 3. Desktop Software Telemetry
sections.body: ShelfMaster operates 100% offline. We collect zero telemetry, zero usage analytics, and zero Personally Identifiable Information (PII) from your desktop installation. All data remains isolated on your local SQLite database.

sections.heading: 4. WordPress Plugin Telemetry
sections.body: Smart Affiliate Link Cloaker uses a cookie-less link redirection engine. Click statistics are logged anonymously without storing IP addresses or Personally Identifiable Information (PII).

sections.heading: 5. Contact Us
sections.body: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact our engineering helpdesk at vibepress.studio@proton.me.
